nodes.label: shadcn/ui Accessibility Patterns
nodes.rationale: Reference doc covering ARIA patterns, keyboard navigation, screen reader support, form accessibility, WCAG contrast, and testing.

nodes.label: Radix UI Primitives
nodes.rationale: Foundation: shadcn/ui built on Radix UI unstyled accessible components following WAI-ARIA design patterns with built-in keyboard navigation and ARIA.

nodes.label: Focus Management
nodes.rationale: Keyboard navigation: focus-visible ring states, skip-to-content links, dialog focus trap, focus returns to trigger on close.

nodes.label: Dialog Focus Trap
nodes.rationale: Dialog/modal navigation: Radix Dialog traps focus automatically, Esc closes, Tab cycles focusable elements, focus returns to trigger.

nodes.label: ARIA Labels
nodes.rationale: Screen reader support: label interactive elements with aria-label, describe with aria-describedby, sr-only screen-reader-only text.

nodes.label: Live Regions
nodes.rationale: Screen reader support: announce dynamic content via aria-live polite/assertive, toast component auto-announced to screen readers.

nodes.label: Form Accessibility
nodes.rationale: Form accessibility: always label inputs, FormDescription/FormMessage, aria-invalid, required fields, fieldset and legend grouping.

nodes.label: WCAG Color Contrast
nodes.rationale: Color contrast requirements: AA 4.5:1 normal / 3:1 large text, AAA 7:1 / 4.5:1, use semantic muted foreground.

nodes.label: Prefers Reduced Motion
nodes.rationale: Motion and animation: respect prefers-reduced-motion, set animation/transition duration to 0.01ms, motion-reduce:transition-none.

nodes.label: axe-core Testing
nodes.rationale: Testing: Lighthouse, axe DevTools, NVDA/JAWS, keyboard-only, color contrast checkers; automated @axe-core/react audit in development.
